property_summary: For all callers, only the deployer-admin can successfully call setOwner; the mutant inverts the require so some non-admin caller can (or the admin cannot) change owner, so there exists an input caller for which owner differs between reference and mutant.
change_summary: Inverted the onlyAdmin require to require msg.sender != admin, which flips access control so admin cannot call setOwner, altering owner after calls that previously succeeded.
